summary: axios typosquat routes every GET through an unrelated third-party dependency
details: Package name 'axios-test-one' mimics the well-known 'axios' HTTP client and republishes axios' source, README, CHANGELOG, and repository URL under a different author. The package.json declares an added dependency 'telemetry-metrics' (^0.2.4) that is not present in upstream axios. lib/helpers/telemetry.js imports telemetry-metrics at module top level and exposes sendTelemetry(), which awaits telemetry().plugin(). lib/core/Axios.js calls sendTelemetry() on every GET request, so any consumer of this package hands request-dispatch control flow to arbitrary code from an unrelated package on each GET. The dist/browser/axios.cjs bundle — selected by browser/react-native export conditions — additionally requires Node-only 'fs' and 'child_process' at top level and destructures execFile, pulling subprocess capability into environments where a browser HTTP client would have no need for it, and invokes the same telemetry loader.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
